svg.title: Compiling text-2.1.4: GHC on one core against AIHC on 12 workers
svg.desc: Gantt chart of a measured build of the text library. GHC compiles 54 modules one at a time in 28.0 seconds. AIHC runs parse, resolve, type-check and backend tasks across 12 workers and finishes in 3.2 seconds.

g.text: 8.8× less wall-clock for the same 54 modules.
Idle rows are idle cores. GHC left 11 of them idle for the whole build.
Apple M4 Pro, 12 cores · GHC: cabal build, -O0, no -j · AIHC: default, -O0 · real traces, medians of 5 runs
